title: Dragon Portal Wagon Ride
description: A dramatic fantasy scene shows a blonde woman in a black dress pulling a red Radio Flyer wagon containing a bearded man holding a fast food bucket. A blue winged demon with horns walks beside them. In the background a massive black dragon emerges from a glowing green portal set in an ancient stone archway, as lightning strikes and dark smoke billows across a purple sky.
prompt: A blonde woman in a flowing black dress pulls a red Radio Flyer wagon across a grassy field. Inside the wagon sits a bearded man eating from a KFC bucket. A muscular blue demon with white wings and horns walks beside them. Behind them a gigantic black dragon with glowing green eyes emerges from a swirling green magical portal framed by an ancient stone arch. Lightning cracks across a stormy purple sky filled with dark smoke, epic cinematic fantasy style, dramatic lighting
